description: This file defines the LeaveEntitlement class in the OrangeHRM system. It models the leave entitlement entity with properties like employee, leave type, date range, number of days, and related metadata, including ORM mappings and business logic methods.

classes.name: LeaveEntitlement
classes.description: Represents a leave entitlement record for an employee, including leave type, date range, number of days, usage, and related metadata, with ORM mappings and class traits for decorators and number formatting.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the unique identifier of the leave entitlement.

methods.name: getEmployee
methods.description: Returns the employee associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setEmployee
methods.description: Sets the employee associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: getNoOfDays
methods.description: Returns the total number of leave days granted.

methods.name: setNoOfDays
methods.description: Sets the total number of leave days granted, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getDaysUsed
methods.description: Returns the number of leave days already used.

methods.name: setDaysUsed
methods.description: Sets the number of leave days used, formatted to 4 decimal places.

methods.name: getLeaveType
methods.description: Returns the leave type associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setLeaveType
methods.description: Sets the leave type for this entitlement.

methods.name: getFromDate
methods.description: Returns the start date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setFromDate
methods.description: Sets the start date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: getToDate
methods.description: Returns the end date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: setToDate
methods.description: Sets the end date of the leave entitlement period.

methods.name: getCreditedDate
methods.description: Returns the date when leave was credited.

methods.name: setCreditedDate
methods.description: Sets the date when leave was credited.

methods.name: getNote
methods.description: Returns the note associated with this entitlement.

methods.name: setNote
methods.description: Sets the note for this entitlement.

methods.name: getEntitlementType
methods.description: Returns the entitlement type.

methods.name: setEntitlementType
methods.description: Sets the entitlement type.

methods.name: isDeleted
methods.description: Returns whether the record is marked as deleted.

methods.name: setDeleted
methods.description: Marks the record as deleted or not.

methods.name: getCreatedBy
methods.description: Returns the user who created this record.

methods.name: setCreatedBy
methods.description: Sets the user who created this record.
